title: The plane that lost a wall at 16,000 feet
caption:
Four bolts. Zero bolts. One very breezy flight. ✈️
Cabin pressure pushes outward on every panel of a jet at altitude, so a door plug with no bolts in it is just a door.
Would you still pick the window seat?
sources: NTSB, Alaska Airlines Flight 1282 (5 January 2024): door plug departed at about 16,000 ft; four retaining bolts not reinstalled after factory rework
NTSB: seats 26A and 26B were unoccupied; all on board survived; a passenger's iPhone was found working in a yard in Portland
